title: osEngineer evaluation-harness policy
description: Decision rules for a detector/classifier/scanner improvement loop, as data. bin/ose-eval-gate reads this policy plus a baseline and a candidate metrics file and returns ACCEPT or REVERT with reasons. Every threshold the loop applies must be declared here; a number that is not in the policy does not exist. Gates are always evaluated per set, never on a sum across sets (the only sum is the documented single-sample tolerance condition).

sets.description: Every labeled set the harness measures, keyed by the set name used in the metrics files.

epsilon.description: Float comparison slack only. Not a minimum gain.

min_dev_f1_gain.description: Minimum F1 gain on a PRIMARY dev set for it to count as an improvement. Defaults to 0: the loop has no implicit threshold.

single_sample_tolerance.description: An F1 drop on one set caused by losing at most max_tp_loss TP is allowed when that set's precision does not drop and the sum of F1 over the PRIMARY holdout sets rises (example: a PRIMARY holdout set going TP 54 -> 53 while FP goes 2 -> 0).

recall_only_max_tp_loss.description: TP a RECALL-ONLY set may lose. Default 0: recall must not drop by even one TP.

generalization.description: For each PRIMARY dev set with a gain and a holdout twin: holdout_gain >= k * dev_gain. Optionally applies only to large gains on small sets.

min_dev_tp_gain.description: Apply only when the dev TP gain is at least this. Omit to always apply.

max_dev_positives.description: Apply only to dev sets with fewer positives than this. Omit to always apply.

bootstrap.description: Paired bootstrap on per-sample predictions of each gaining PRIMARY dev set; the gain counts only if the lower bound of the confidence interval of F1(candidate) - F1(baseline) is above 0. Requires `predictions` in both metrics files for those sets.

metric.description: Per-set latency field in the metrics files.

budget_ms.description: Revert when a candidate set exceeds it and got slower. Omit for no budget.

noise_pct.description: Run-to-run variance. Changes within it are neither gains nor regressions.

latency_only_accept.description: Accept when every labeled count is identical, at least one set got faster beyond noise, and none got slower.

sealed.description: A SEALED set is never measured inside an iteration; it is read only at round or release boundaries, at a fixed cadence (Dwork et al. 2015, arXiv:1506.02629).

corpus_drop_requires_fp_reduction.description: Revert when unlabeled corpus findings fall while no labeled set lost an FP.

require_distinct_version_labels.description: Refuse a candidate whose version label equals the baseline's (measured before the bump).

require_clean_tree.description: Refuse a candidate measured on a dirty working tree.

loop.description: Loop cadence. Read by the recipe and the eval-harness-engineer agent, not by the gate.

role.description: PRIMARY: F1/precision gate, dev gains count. RECALL-ONLY: positives-only, recall gate. GUARD-ONLY: F1/precision gate, gains never count, never a hypothesis source. REPORT-ONLY: recorded, never gates. SEALED: read only at round/release boundaries.

holdout.description: Name of this dev set's holdout twin, for the generalization gate.
